Logs never leave the machine.**"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Coding agents constantly need to answer *"what happened around 3pm yesterday?"*. Generic log tools m"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ake you hand-write `grep` pipelines and timestamp math. `log_query` resolves the fuzzy Chinese time "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"expression for you and returns **structured, machine-readable matches** the agent can reason over di"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"rectly — no parsing prose out of terminal output."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| 🕐 **Chinese time parsing** | Absolute dates (`2026-07-03`, `7月3日 09:15`), relative (`3小时前`, `昨天`, "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"`上周三`), fuzzy windows (`下午`, `凌晨`), hour ranges (`14:00-15:00`) — each with a confidence score |
| 📄"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" **Multi-format logs** | Auto-detected timestamp formats, UTF-8/GBK encoding fallback, streaming fil"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ter (no full-file load, ~2.4s per 300k lines) |
| 🔒 **Offline by default** | Zero third-party Python"},{"id":"p9s5","text":" dependencies; log contents never leave the machine |
| 🧩 **Structured output** | Canonical JSON (`t"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"ime_range`, `filter`, `lines`, `stats`) rendered as readable text for the model, spill-safe under th"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"e harness's 50KB inline budget |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**Prerequisites**: a dsh profile (`web` or `headless`) + **Python 3.9+** on the machine (on Windows,"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" the `py` launcher is auto-detected when `python` is missing)."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**Local / development** (from a checkout):"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**Community install** — once listed in awesome-dsh-plugin, install via the plugin market (GitHub-onl"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"y plugins are supported):"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"**Compatibility**: tested against `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools@0.1.0-rc.6` (current harness release line,"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" e.g. `dsh-base@0.1.0-rc.5`)."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Tell the agent to use the tool — no special syntax needed:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"> 用 log_query 查一下 demo.log 里 2026-07-03 的 ERROR 情况"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Parameters"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| Parameter | Type | Description |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| `time_text` | string **(required)** | Chinese natural-language time, e.g. 「昨天下午」「3小时前」 |
| `files`"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" | string[] | Log file paths (absolute or workspace-relative) |
| `dir` | string | Directory to scan"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" recursively |
| `pattern` | string | Glob when `dir` is set (default `*.log`) |
| `max_lines` | num"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ber | Max lines returned (default 500; `0` = stats only; capped at 5000) |
| `since` | string | RFC3"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"339 absolute-time fallback when `time_text` fails to parse |
| `timezone` | string | IANA timezone n"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"ame, e.g. `Asia/Shanghai` |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The tool runs in **offline mode by default**: it filters precisely (its unique value), and leaves ro"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ot-cause reasoning to the agent itself."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The plugin shells out to a vendored copy of the LogTimeline Python CLI (`python/lq.py --json --no-ll"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"m`), so the battle-tested parsing/filtering logic stays untouched. Vendoring changes are minimal and"},{"id":"p27s3","text":" documented in `python/VENDORED.md`."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"`tests/query.test.ts` runs the real vendored Python CLI against fixture logs; `tests/host.test.ts` l"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"oads the built plugin (`lib/`) into a minimal Cordis container, applies it, and validates the canoni"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"cal value against the `output.schema` contract. Peer packages (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*`, pinned to the `"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"0.1.0-rc.6` line) are installed as devDependencies so the runtime import chain resolves outside a DS"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"c.6` line) are installed as devDependencies so the runtime import chain resolves outside a DSH host."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Security & Privacy"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- **No key handling**: the plugin reads no API keys, stores no credentials, and makes no outbound ca"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"lls — log analysis is 100% local
- **No log exfiltration**: log lines are returned to the agent (the"},{"id":"p32s3","text":" model) as tool results, never sent anywhere else
- **Path scoping**: only the paths the model passe"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"s (via `files`/`dir`) are read; the tool is read-only, it never writes or deletes log files
